summary: Carter Bankshares, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the completed sale of its membership interest in Bearing Insurance Group, LLC to an unaffiliated third party, effective May 1, 2026. The estimated pre-tax gain is approximately $35.8 million, to be recognized in Q2 2026. No specific price per share, premium, or break fee was disclosed. The board did not issue a recommendation; the transaction closed on announcement. The filing provides no structural mechanics beyond the gain estimate. The closed nature means no regulatory clock remains; watch for subsequent earnings reports to confirm actual gain and potential redeployment of proceeds.
